variables.name: notificationType
variables.comment: Type of notification: 0 = code1; 1 = code2

variables.name: code
variables.comment: TS 27.007 7.17 "code1" or "code2"

variables.name: type
variables.comment: TS 27.007 7.17 "type" (MT only)

variables.name: number
variables.comment: TS 27.007 7.17 "number" (MT only)

variables.name: history
variables.comment: List of forwarded numbers, if any

variables.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1
variables.comment:
* Notification type is from the "code 1" group (per TS 27.007 7.17).
     * This means the {@link #code} will be a code such as {@link #CODE_1_CALL_FORWARDED}.

variables.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2
variables.comment:
* Notification type is from the "code 2" group (per TS 27.007 7.17).
     * This means the {@link #code} will be a code such as {@link #CODE_2_CALL_ON_HOLD}.

variables.name: CODE_1_UNCONDITIONAL_CF_ACTIVE
variables.comment:
* Indicates that unconditional call forwarding is active.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_SOME_CF_ACTIVE
variables.comment:
* Indicates that some conditional call forwarding options are active.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_CALL_FORWARDED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an outgoing call has been forwarded to another number.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_CALL_IS_WAITING
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an outgoing call is waiting.  This means that the called party is already in
     * another call and is hearing the call waiting tone.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_CUG_CALL
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an outgoing call is to a number in a closed user group.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_OUTGOING_CALLS_BARRED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that outgoing calls are barred.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_INCOMING_CALLS_BARRED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that incoming calls are barred.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_CLIR_SUPPRESSION_REJECTED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that CLIR suppression has been rejected for an outgoing call.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_1_CALL_DEFLECTED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an outgoing call bas been deflected to another number.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_1}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_FORWARDED_CALL
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an incoming call is a forwarded call.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_CUG_CALL
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an incoming call is from a member of a closed user group.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_CALL_ON_HOLD
variables.comment:
* Indicates that a call has been remotely put on hold.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_CALL_RETRIEVED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that a call has been remotely resumed (retrieved).
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_MULTI_PARTY_CALL
variables.comment:
* Indicates that a conference call has been entered.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_ON_HOLD_CALL_RELEASED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an ongoing call on hold has been released.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_FORWARD_CHECK_RECEIVED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that a forward check message was received.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_CALL_CONNECTING_ECT
variables.comment:
* Indicates that a call is being connected (alerting) with another party as a result of an
     * explicit call transfer operation.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_CALL_CONNECTED_ECT
variables.comment:
* Indicates that a call has been connected with another party as a result of an explicit call
     * transfer operation.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_DEFLECTED_CALL
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an outgoing call has been deflected to another number.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.

variables.name: CODE_2_ADDITIONAL_CALL_FORWARDED
variables.comment:
* Indicates that an additional incoming call has been forwarded.
     * Valid {@link #code} when {@link #type} is {@link #NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE_2}.
     * See TS 27.007 7.17.
